form_title: Financial Campaign Report for County and Local School Board Candidates

reports.report_type_printed: Seven days preceding the Primary Election
reports.notes: Typed fillable form, printed and scanned via CamScanner (a 'Scanned with CamScanner' watermark sits in the bottom-right of both pages). The Office field is the one HANDWRITTEN field on the cover, in block capitals: 'UTAH COUNTY COMMISSION SEAT B' (index.csv 'County Commission Seat B' - agrees). Street address, phone number and signature are redacted upstream by the county; the printed city 'Spanish Fork, UT 84660' and the email survive. Summary figures are typed without dollar signs and without thousands separators. PAGE-COUNT INCONSISTENCY inside the filing: the cover's Page box reads '1 of 7' while the summary page's reads '8 of 8' (the PDF has 8 pages) - the filer's own numbering, recorded not corrected. Cover prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov'.
